slides.headline: GENERIC CHECKLISTS LEAVE GAPS.
slides.sub: And the gap is where the refusal lives.
slides.note: What you need depends on nationality, residence, destination, purpose and funding. No single list covers all of that.

slides.headline: WHAT MOST LISTS INCLUDE
slides.footnote: All necessary. None of it sufficient on its own.

slides.answer: THE LIST IS NOT THE HARD PART.
slides.body: Making it agree with itself is. Your statement should support your itinerary. Your itinerary should match your reservations. Your letter should explain both.
slides.note: One date that drifts, and the whole file starts being read differently.

slides.headline: HOW FILES ACTUALLY FAIL
slides.never: Tick every box on a downloaded list and assume that is enough. Officers are not auditing a checklist — they are checking whether the set of documents tells one coherent story.
slides.instead: Cross-check every document against every other before submission. Dates, amounts, addresses, purpose. We do this on every file as a matter of routine.
